usageNotes: Performs a hard stop-then-start of the specified Proxmox system service on the target node; prefer the reload endpoint when the service supports it to minimize downtime. The caller must hold Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}. Restarting critical cluster services such as pve-cluster, corosync, or pvedaemon will briefly interrupt cluster communication and API availability — use with care in production.

examples.summary: Restart the PVE proxy (web UI / API listener) on node pve1

tips: Use the reload endpoint instead of restart for pveproxy and pvedaemon when you only need to apply a config change — reload avoids a full service stop.
Restarting corosync or pve-cluster can trigger quorum re-evaluation; ensure a majority of cluster nodes are online before doing so.
Restarting sshd will drop active SSH sessions to the node, including the one issuing the call if run interactively.
The returns type is a UPID string — poll the node tasks endpoint to confirm the restart completed successfully.
